activities.name: Eiffel Tower Summit Access & Champagne Toast
activities.description: You will ascend to the highest accessible observation deck in Europe via glass elevators, taking in a 360-degree panoramic view of the Paris skyline. Once at the top, you can toast the city with a glass of crisp Moët & Chandon champagne while watching the tower's diamond lights sparkle from the inside out.
activities.location: Champ de Mars, 5 Av. Anatole France, 75007 Paris
activities.duration_note: Advance online booking required up to 60 days in advance; summit access may be closed during high winds.

activities.name: Louvre Museum Masterpieces After-Hours Guided Tour
activities.description: You will skip the daytime crowds and navigate the palatial corridors of the world's largest museum alongside an expert art historian. Get up close to the Mona Lisa, the Venus de Milo, and the Winged Victory of Samothrace while learning the hidden political scandals and artistic rivalries behind their creation.
activities.duration_note: Available on select evening openings (Wednesdays and Fridays); includes skip-the-line museum entry ticket.

activities.name: Artisanal Cheese & Baguette Tasting at Fromagerie Laurent Dubois
activities.description: You will step inside a legendary affineur’s aging cellar to sample rare, raw-milk cheeses like aged Comté, creamy Mont d'Or, and pungent Roquefort paired with warm, crackling traditional baguettes. Guided by a master cheesemonger, you'll learn the strict AOC laws governing French dairy and how to properly cut and pair each variety.
activities.duration_note: Requires advance registration; alternative options provided for pasteurized dairy restrictions upon request.

activities.name: Pastry & Macaron Masterclass at Alain Ducasse’s Studio
activities.description: You will don an apron in a state-of-the-art kitchen to master the delicate art of French pastry making under the guidance of a Michelin-trained pastry chef. You'll learn the precision piping techniques for multi-flavored macarons, the secrets to a perfect choux pastry, and how to temper chocolate like a true Parisian professional.
activities.duration_note: All equipment and ingredients included; you take home a box of your own handmade creations.

activities.name: VIP Champagne Revue at the Moulin Rouge
activities.description: You will spend an iconic Parisian evening inside the historic birthplace of the French Cancan, watching the spectacular 'Féerie' show featuring 100 artists and thousands of feather costumes. Your ticket secures premium seating and a chilled half-bottle of premium French champagne served during the performance.
activities.duration_note: Strict elegant dress code enforced (no shorts, sportswear, or sneakers); minimum age is 6 years.

activities.name: Underground Jazz Session at Le Duc des Lombards
activities.description: You will immerse yourself in Paris's premier historic jazz venue, taking a front-row seat in an intimate, moody basement club frequented by international virtuosos. Savor bespoke cocktails while experiencing acoustic sets that pay homage to the post-war golden age of jazz in Paris.
activities.duration_note: Highly recommended to book table reservations; standard cover charge does not include drinks.

activities.name: Palace of Versailles King's Apartments & Hall of Mirrors Access
activities.description: You will wander through the absolute height of 17th-century French Baroque extravagance, exploring the private bedchambers of Louis XIV before stepping into the breathtaking Hall of Mirrors. Outside, you'll walk through the manicured groves and grand fountains of the geometric royal gardens.
activities.duration_note: Passport timed-entry ticket required; fountain shows run on specific days from April to October.

activities.name: Bouldering Expedition in the Fontainebleau Forest
activities.description: You will tackle the legendary sandstone boulders of 'Bleau', the birthplace of modern bouldering, accompanied by a certified wilderness climbing guide. Whether you are a beginner or an advanced climber, you'll learn to navigate the unique grip and technical mantles of these world-famous forest rock formations.
activities.duration_note: Includes climbing shoes, chalk bags, and crash pad rentals; requires moderate physical fitness.

activities.name: Private Venetian Water Limousine Cruise on the Seine
activities.description: You will cruise down the Seine in a luxury, custom-built wooden water taxi, passing under historic bridges like Pont Alexandre III without the crowds of standard tour boats. Sip high-end French wine while listening to a curated soundtrack as the Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Louvre drift beautifully past your open-air cockpit.
activities.duration_note: Price is flat rate per boat for up to 6 passengers; operates rain or shine due to covered cabin option.

activities.name: Whitewater Kayaking Through Europe's Grand Canyon
activities.description: You will paddle down the emerald-green waters of the Verdon River, navigating thrilling Class II and III rapids framed by vertical limestone cliffs rising up to 700 meters above you. This guided expedition takes you into the deepest, most dramatic recesses of the canyon where dramatic rock arches and hidden beaches await.
activities.location: Castellane launch site, 04120 Gorges du Verdon
activities.duration_note: Must be able to swim at least 25 meters; seasonal operational window runs from May to September.

activities.name: E-Bike Photography Tour of Blooming Lavender Fields
activities.description: You will glide effortlessly on a premium electric bicycle through endless geometric rows of vibrant, aromatic lavender fields in the heart of rural Provence. Led by a local photographer, you'll discover hidden paths away from tourists and learn how to capture the perfect golden-hour shots against rolling alpine backdrops.
activities.duration_note: Strictly seasonal; peak bloom occurs from mid-June to late July. Helmets and water provided.

activities.name: Bespoke Perfume Creation at Studio Molinard
activities.description: You will step into the historic capital of perfume and sit at a private fragrance organ featuring over 90 precious essential oils and essences. Under the guidance of a master 'Nez' (Nose), you will select your favorite base, heart, and top notes to formulate and bottle your own signature 50ml French fragrance.
activities.duration_note: Your custom recipe is archived permanently so you can re-order your personalized scent online later.

activities.name: Cours Saleya Food Market Crawl & Socca Tasting
activities.description: You will push through the striped awnings of Nice’s most famous open-air market to taste authentic Niçoise specialties straight from the copper pans. Savor hot, crispy Socca (chickpea pancake), savory Pissaladière (onion and anchovy tart), and fresh tapenades made with globally protected local Cailletier olives.
activities.duration_note: Runs Tuesday through Sunday morning; come hungry as tastings equal a full, hearty lunch.

activities.name: High-Stakes Evening at the Casino de Monte-Carlo
activities.description: You will enter the ultra-luxurious world of Belle Époque architecture, walking past a fleet of supercars into the world's most famous gambling salon. Test your luck at French Roulette or Texas Hold'em underneath crystal chandeliers, or enjoy a classic Vesper Martini at the glamorous Salle Blanche bar.
activities.duration_note: Strict smart-casual dress code required (jacket recommended after 8 PM); valid passport mandatory for entry.

activities.name: VIP Dance Session at Les Caves du Roy
activities.description: You will party alongside international jet-setters and celebrities at the crown jewel of the French Riviera’s clubbing scene, located inside the Hotel Byblos. Dance under a canopy of glowing, iconic indoor palm trees to tracks spun by world-famous DJs while experiencing epic champagne showers.
activities.duration_note: Extremely strict door policy; entry fee can skyrocket during summer weekends and tables require heavy spend minimums.

activities.name: Cliffside Panoramic Walk and Exotic Garden Viewpoint
activities.description: You will climb the steep, winding medieval stone alleys of the eagle's nest village of Éze to its highest point. At the summit, wander through a botanical garden of rare cacti and succulents while taking in an uninhibited, jaw-dropping panoramic view across the entire Mediterranean coastline.
activities.duration_note: Requires climbing steep stone steps on foot; wearing sturdy walking shoes with good grip is highly advised.

activities.name: Sailing Catamaran & Snorkeling Cruise around Île Sainte-Marguerite
activities.description: You will board a large luxury catamaran from Cannes and sail out into the clear waters of the Lerins Islands archipelago. Anchor in secluded turquoise lagoons to swim and snorkel among Mediterranean marine life and view the unique underwater eco-museum statues.
activities.duration_note: Includes snorkel gear and a complimentary glass of local Provence rosé; available May through October.

activities.name: Thermal Bath Hydrotherapy Ritual at Thermes Sextius
activities.description: You will relax your muscles in natural mineral-rich thermal waters that have been celebrated since ancient Roman times. This luxurious ritual includes access to the historic sensory pools, traditional steam hammams, and a restorative full-body massage using organic Mediterranean essential oils.
activities.duration_note: Proper swimwear required (swim caps and speedo-style briefs for men may be mandatory depending on current house rules).

activities.name: Paragliding Over Europe's Tallest Sand Dune
activities.description: You will strap into a tandem paraglider and launch from the crest of the massive Dune of Pilat, soaring high on the coastal thermal winds. You will look down on a dramatic landscape where towering yellow sand pines meet the crashing blue waves of the Atlantic Ocean and the sandbanks of Arcachon Bay.
activities.duration_note: Highly dependent on wind conditions; weight limits typically between 40kg and 100kg apply for safety.

activities.name: Château Pichon Baron Grand Cru Barrel Tasting & Estate Tour
activities.description: You will step behind the fairytale turrets of an iconic Grand Cru Classé estate to see the state-of-the-art gravity-fed winery and subterranean cellars. An estate sommelier will lead you through an exclusive tasting of historic, collector-grade Cabernet Sauvignon blends sampled straight from French oak barrels.
activities.duration_note: Advance online reservation mandatory weeks in advance; children under 18 allowed on tour but cannot drink alcohol.

activities.name: Tasting Fresh Atlantic Oysters at a Working Cabane d'Oustréiculteur
activities.description: You will sit at a wooden picnic table directly over the water inside a rustic oyster farmer's shack on the edge of the basin. Enjoy a dozen ultra-fresh oysters harvested just hours before, paired traditionally with buttered rye bread, local spicy crépinette sausage, and a chilled bottle of Entre-Deux-Mers white wine.
activities.duration_note: Outdoor seating is exposed to coastal weather; optimal during high tide for the best waterfront views.

activities.name: Canelé Baking Workshop & Pastry History Class
activities.description: You will master the intricate process of creating Bordeaux's signature pastry: the Canelé, famous for its dark, caramelized exterior and soft, rum-and-vanilla custard center. Learn why copper molds and local beeswax are essential to getting the perfect crunch, and discover the sweet link between this pastry and the city's historic winemaking trade.
activities.duration_note: Includes a box of freshly baked pastries to take away; alternatives for alcohol-free diets are available.

activities.name: Electronic Beats Night at IBOAT Ferry Club
activities.description: You will climb aboard a converted historic three-deck ferry anchored in Bordeaux’s trendy dry docks, now operating as a legendary underground nightclub. Dance deep inside the concrete hull to cutting-edge house and techno sets mixed by international underground DJs, or relax with a craft beer on the open-air heated top deck.
activities.location: Bassin à Flot n°1, Cours Henri Brunet, 33300 Bordeaux
activities.duration_note: Club events generally kick off at midnight; proper ID must be shown to security at the gangway.

activities.name: Surfing Masterclass at Côte des Basques Beach
activities.description: You will paddle out into the birthplace of European surfing, catching long rolling Atlantic waves under the guidance of a top Basque surf instructor. You'll master the fundamentals of pop-ups and ocean safety while riding waves backdropped by the rugged Pyrenees mountains and dramatic seaside villas.
activities.location: Boulevard du Prince de Galles, 64200 Biarritz
activities.duration_note: Includes high-quality surfboard and seasonal wetsuit rentals; class schedules change daily based on tides.

activities.name: Bordeaux Wine Interactive Journey at La Cité du Vin
activities.description: You will explore an architectural marvel shaped like a swirling wine decanter, navigating high-tech immersive exhibits that showcase global winemaking history. Conclude your tour high up on the 8th-floor open belvedere deck, enjoying a complimentary glass of premium wine with panoramic views across the Garonne River.
activities.duration_note: Includes a multi-language digital audio guide headset; highly family-friendly with non-alcoholic grape juice options.

activities.name: Thermal Detox Spa Escape at Les Prés d'Eugénie
activities.description: You will retreat into a historic thermal station designed by Michel Guérard, indulging in therapeutic mud baths and high-pressure mineral water massages. This wellness journey uses curative local thermal hot springs surrounded by peaceful white-stone gardens to completely restore balance to your body.
activities.duration_note: Advance reservation needed; guests have access to the pristine property and relaxation lounges.

activities.name: Guided Quickstand Trek Across the Mont Saint-Michel Bay
activities.description: You will strip off your shoes and trek barefoot across the dramatic tidal mudflats surrounding Europe’s most iconic island abbey. An experienced naturalist guide will lead you safely past sinking quicksand patches while explaining the extreme, fast-moving tides that completely cut off the mountain twice a day.
activities.duration_note: Barefoot walking required; participants must have good mobility and prepare to get mud up to their knees.

activities.name: D-Day Landing Beaches & American Cemetery Historical Tour
activities.description: You will walk the hallowed sand historic sectors of Omaha Beach and stand inside the preserved German concrete blockhouses at Pointe du Hoc. Pay tribute at the Normandy American Cemetery, where 9,387 white marble crosses stand in perfect alignment over the cliffs overlooking the Atlantic coast.
activities.duration_note: Dress warmly as high winds and rain are common on the coastal bluffs; museum entry is included.

activities.name: Aged Calvados & Camembert Tasting at Calvados Pierre Huet
activities.description: You will tour a classic half-timbered Normandy estate to see traditional copper stills distilling apple cider into world-class brandy. Sit in the oak barrel cellar to sample rich, double-distilled Calvados spirits paired beautifully with gooey, unpasteurized local Camembert and Pont-l'Évêque cheeses.
activities.duration_note: Non-alcoholic fresh organic apple juice and sparkling apple ciders are available for younger visitors.

activities.name: Traditional Breton Galette Class at Atelier de la Crêpe
activities.description: You will master the art of using a 'rozell' (wooden T-stick) to spread buckwheat batter thinly onto a screaming hot cast-iron billig griddle. Craft an authentic savory Breton galette stuffed with salted butter, artisanal ham, and melted Gruyère, all paired with a traditional ceramic bowl of bubbly local cider.
activities.duration_note: Naturally gluten-free as authentic galettes use 100% pure buckwheat flour; registration essential.

activities.name: Breton Pub Hopping on Rue de la Soif
activities.description: You will immerse yourself in the nightlife of Rennes along Saint-Michel street, famously nicknamed 'Thirst Street' due to its high concentration of bars inside 15th-century timber buildings. Grab a wooden table at La Cité or Le Gazoline to enjoy craft beers and regional chouchen (honey mead) alongside university crowds.
activities.duration_note: The street gets extremely packed on Thursday and Saturday nights during the university academic semesters.

activities.name: Cliffside Hiking Along the Aval Alabaster Arches
activities.description: You will hike scenic clifftop trails rising over a hundred meters above the sea, admiring the dramatic natural chalk arches and needle formations of Étretat that inspired Claude Monet. Look down at crashing waves on the pebble beaches below and feel the brisk wind of the English Channel.
activities.duration_note: Entirely free public path; hikers must keep a safe distance from fragile, unfenced cliff edges.

activities.name: Catamaran Cruise Around the Megalithic Islands
activities.description: You will set sail across an inland sea dotted with dozens of legendary green islands, navigating deep channels rich with seabirds. Drop anchor at the island of Gavrinis to step ashore and explore a prehistoric passage grave filled with intricate, Neolithic stone carvings dating back to 3500 BC.
activities.duration_note: Abbey/tomb access requires negotiating narrow entryways; runs regularly from April through October.

activities.name: Tandem Paragliding Over the Mont Blanc Massif
activities.description: You will take a leap from the Planpraz cable car station at 2,000 meters, soaring into the sky with a professional Alpine pilot. You'll glide past steep granite walls, massive glaciers, and the majestic snow-capped peak of Mont Blanc itself, before touching down softly in the valley floor.
activities.duration_note: Includes lift ticket to the jump platform; passengers must wear thick warm layers and sturdy shoes.

activities.name: Renaissance Traboules Architectural Walking Tour
activities.description: You will unlock heavy, nondescript wooden doors to discover the secret Renaissance corridors and spiral staircases hidden inside Lyon’s oldest neighborhood. An expert historical guide will lead you through these medieval covered passages ('traboules'), explaining how they were used by silk weavers and French Resistance fighters.
activities.duration_note: Quiet behavior mandatory within passages, as these historic networks cross through private residential buildings.

activities.name: Authentic Lyonnais Offal Dinner at a Certified Bouchon
activities.description: You will squeeze into a wood-paneled bistro holding the official 'Les Bouchons Lyonnais' seal to sample traditional working-class cuisine. Dine on rich quenelles de brochet (piked fish dumplings in crayfish sauce), savory andouillette sausage, and cervelle de canut cheese spread, all served with a carafe of Beaujolais wine.
activities.duration_note: Advance weekend dinner booking highly recommended; vegetarian options are limited due to traditional menus.

activities.name: Alpine Fondue & Raclette Evening in a Secluded Mountain Refuge
activities.description: You will travel up snow-covered trails via snowshoe or sled to reach a cozy, candlelit timber refuge far above the ski lines. Melt individual wheels of raw-milk Beaufort and Abondance cheese over open fires, scraping it across cured Alpine meats, potatoes, and pickled cornichons.
activities.duration_note: Winter exclusive (December to April); includes guided snowshoe hike up and back down from the cabin.

activities.name: Open-Air Après-Ski Party at La Folie Douce
activities.description: You will ski straight onto the snow-covered dance floor of Europe's highest open-air club, located at 2,600 meters elevation. Experience a high-energy mix of live saxophonists, aerial acrobats, and world-class house DJs performing on elevated stages against a backdrop of endless snowy peaks.
activities.location: Plein Sud Ski Lift Top Station, 73700 Val Thorens
activities.duration_note: Free entry for skiers; VIP table bookings incur extra costs. Music wraps up right before the last lifts close.

activities.name: Aiguille du Midi Cable Car Ride & Step Into the Void
activities.description: You will board a record-breaking vertical cable car to ascend to a rocky crag at 3,842 meters in less than 20 minutes. Stand inside a five-sided clear glass skywalk box with a terrifying one-kilometer drop directly under your feet, enjoying views of Switzerland and Italy.
activities.location: 100 Place de l'Aiguille du Midi, 74400 Chamonix
activities.duration_note: Warm winter clothing and sunglasses essential year-round; not recommended for individuals with cardiac conditions due to altitude change.

activities.name: Wakesurfing & Kayaking in Europe's Cleanest Alpine Lake
activities.description: You will skim across the glassy, mountain-rimmed waters of Lake Annecy on a premium speed boat tailored for wakesurfing and paddle sports. Dive into pure, crystal-clear glacial waters or paddle deep along the rocky cliffs of the Roc de Chère nature reserve in a sea kayak.
activities.duration_note: Operates during summer months (June to September); all high-grade wetsuits and board gear included.
